qt: to the Commission Anders Vistisen (PfE) Subject:

Will the Commission set up a task force – possibly in cooperation with the Covid Vaccine Injury Alliance1 – in order to identify the challenges facing the group of patients concerned and find solutions?

Will the Commission ensure that all EU citizens who have suffered Covid-vaccinerelated harm have access to systematic diagnosis and effective treatment, and will it publicly acknowledge citizens who have been harmed as a result of Covid vaccination in order to put a stop to stigmatisation?
Will the Commission undertake to establish fair and comprehensive financial compensation for EU citizens who have been harmed as a result of Covid vaccination?
